notes.title: Release 1.2.1
notes.content: Quick fix allowing users to once again get the beating map 1 achievements. Was broken as of the last update.

notes.title: Release 1.2.0 - New Map! Great Cave Defensive Reversed!
notes.content:
In this latest update, we've introduced an inverted version of Map 1 – Great Cave Defensive. Accessible from the hub, this inverted map provides a fresh perspective on the familiar terrain.

This version of the map can be played via the same cave in the lobby that takes you to Map 1, but be careful this version is substantially harder than the regular version.

Lobbies are also connected between the regular, and reversed versions of maps, this means that you'll see people swinging upside down in the direction you're climbing away from!

In the event of bugs, please report them on our [url=https://spiderslingers.com/discord]Discord[/url] or comment them here.

Good luck completing this one! It's a challenge!
Ryan

notes.title: Release 1.1.4 - January Cosmetics!
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

This update adds our first alternative skins to the game! Seven new skins for your spider! They will be available for purchase throughout January and then vanish from the store after that!

They are called Tumblers, they roll around as you swing!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AtbQmzm.png[/img]

notes.title: Release 1.1.3
notes.content:
If you purchased the game before it went free to play this update is for you! Exclusive cosmetics!

[b]New Cosmetics[/b]
[list]
[*] Supporter Crown Hat, a solid gold crown. (For those who purchased the game before it went free to play)
[*] Supporter Skin, a solid gold spider skin (For those who purchased the game before it went free to play)
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]

[*] Throwables no longer break on hitting network players
[*] Input menu now says use G to throw throwables.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.1.2 - Limited Time Christmas Cosmetics, Throwable Cosmetics, and More!
notes.content:
It's late but here are some christmas cosmetics! I'm wanting to ramp up how often I do limited time cosmetics, so I'll be attempting monthly limited edition ones. This update also brings throwable cosmetics, they don't collide with players, but feel free to taunt your friends from above by throwing snowballs at them!

[b]Until December 31st you can purchase a Christmas Tree Hat and a Coal Throwable![/b]

[list]
[*] New Christmas Tree Cosmetic (Available throughout December)
[*] New Coal Throwable Cosmetic (Avaialble throughout December)
[*] New Rock Throwable Cosmetic
[*] New Snow Throwable Cosmetic
[*] New Ears Cosmetic
[*] New Prison Cosmetic
[*] Bug fix where vectors would be incorrectly sent over to other players
[*] Fixed text scaling in the shop
[*] Setup automatic shop events, so now certain halloween, christmas, etc event items will automatically appear during given times.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.1.1
notes.content:
I'm planning on having a few updates big and small come out in the next little while.

[list]
[*] Steam Rich Presence in Main Menu
[*] Steam Rich Presence in Lobby
[*] 3 New Steam Achievements!
[*] Chat Visibility Options (Useful for streamers) Restrict whos chat messages appear for you.
[*] Smaller bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Spider Slingers Now Free!
notes.content:
Hello Fellow Gamers,

Spider Slingers is now free! Hurray! Those who bought the game will get an in-game reward for next update! I still plan on developing the game, but have recouped the major development costs.

Thanks & See you swinging!

Ryan

notes.title: Release 1.10 - The Hub!
notes.content:
[b]The Hub[/b]
This update adds a world hub, via the world hub you can access World 1, and eventually all the future worlds. Minigames are also planned to be added and will also be accessible from the hub. Teleport to the hub in the escape menu or type /hub.

[b]Tutorial[/b]
A short tutorial has been added for those who travel to the world hub for the first time, or you can play it at any time via the main menu or /tutorial.

Let me know if any bugs are found!
